in_sanskrit.name: विष्णुचित्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is devoted to the Lord Vishnu or the one who is a follower of Lord Vishnu.

in_hindi.name: विष्णुचित्
in_hindi.long_meaning: जो विष्णु के प्रति समर्पित है या विष्णु का परिपालक है।

in_tamil.name: விஷ்ணுசித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: விஷ்ணுவின் தோழியாகும் அல்லது விஷ்ணுவின் பாலகர் ஆவார்.

in_telugu.name: విష్ణుచిత్
in_telugu.long_meaning: విష్ణు కు సమర్పితం యాదుట అథవా విష్ణు కు పరిపాలించే వ్యక్తి.

in_marathi.name: Vishnuchit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gift of Lord Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishnuchit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vishnuchit is a name derived from Sanskrit, where Vishnu refers to the Hindu God who preserves the universe and Chit means consciousness or knowledge. Together, Vishnuchit means a gift from Lord Vishnu.

Together, Vishnuchit means a gift from Lord Vishnu.
